title: Saudi Sovereign Wealth Fund Tower Damaged as Houthis Attack Riyadh
summary_full: An aerial attack by the Yemeni militia affected several floors of a skyscraper that is home to the Public Investment Fund, without causing injuries, according to Saudi authorities.
